official_smallNORB.published_variables: paired camera images, category, instance, elevation, azimuth, lighting

additional_primary.title: CNN²: Viewpoint Generalization via a Binocular Vision
additional_primary.facts: Uses binocular classification including smallNORB; parallax augmentation appends hR-hL and hL-hR channels and is an architecture feature construction, not independently sampled AA-style image augmentation.

own_necessary_derivations.name: coordinate_change_not_geometry_annihilation
own_necessary_derivations.assumptions: invertible image homographies, same still-visible scene correspondences, continuous homogeneous coordinates
own_necessary_derivations.interpretation: Old fixed-F or horizontal-line residual may change; transformed geometry is not generally absent. Interpolation/cropping/noninvertibility are separate.

own_necessary_derivations.name: separable_single_image_objective_cannot_detect_coupling_at_fixed_marginals
own_necessary_derivations.assumptions: model and per-image loss do not depend on the paired input or changing batch state; exact augmentation expectation; left/right marginals identical across couplings
own_necessary_derivations.equation: E_Q[ell(f(TL xL),y)+ell(f(TR xR),y)] = E_QL ell(f(TL xL),y)+E_QR ell(f(TR xR),y)
own_necessary_derivations.interpretation: Changing only augmentation coupling has identical objective here. Nonseparable fusion/loss or finite stochastic optimization must be explicit before attributing any effect to stereo geometry.
